name: euler-column-fixed-free-hex20
reference: Benchmark B5: Euler buckling of a fixed-free (cantilever) column, E = 210 GPa, nu = 0.3, 20 x 20 x 1000 mm of hex20. I = b^4 / 12 = 1.3333e-8 m^4, so P_cr = pi^2 EI / (4 L^2) = 6908.72 N against the 1 MPa reference pressure on the 20 x 20 mm free end (P_ref = 400 N): lambda = 17.2718, gated at 1 %. The square section makes the first two modes a degenerate pair -- the same load in two perpendicular planes -- so nModes is 2 and both are checked against the same value, which is what fails if the p + 8 subspace ever shrinks back to the modal path's min(2p, p + 8) and stops separating a pair. The closed form neglects shear; at L/b = 50 that correction is about 0.10 %.
